balls.text: outside the off stump, pitched right up to the bat and missed by Kohli, that ends the Bangalore innings on 215/1!
short ball and that has been pulled over mid-wicket for another four, this time it is Kohli!
slower one and Gayle isn't able to time it properly, gets a single to long-on
I think this is the best of the lot, outside the off stump, yorker length and Gayle just extends his bat out and slashes it over deep point for a six!
slower one from Aaron, swings at it hard but misses it, goes between the stumps and the pads
yorker length ball, into the batsman, driven to long-on for a single
yorker length ball, drilled away to the leg side, to mid-wicket for a single
slower one and that has been lofted to long-on, could have been caught but tips it over bar does Chand, should have been caught!
outside the off stump, way outside and Kohli lets that go for a wide
slower and yet, drilled hard to the off side, to the extra-cover region, they do not go for the single
pitched up outside the off stump and that has been dragged to the mid-wicket region for a four!
short of length, quicker as well, wants to play it over long-on, it rolls down the ground for a single
full toss and driven to wide long-off, could have gone for the second but Gayle wants the strike!
pitched up to the bat, driven to mid-wicket and they go for a single, Aaron at mid-wicket throws the stumps down at the non-striker's end but the batsman is in. Third umpire was called for.
outside the off stump, pitched right up to the bat, slashed over point but the sweeper fielder tidies up and there is a single
pitched on the middle stump and fuller again and it is flicked away over the mid-wicket region for...you know what, six!
short of length and pulled away as well, but this goes squarer than the previous one and to the fielder, single to the captain
outside the off stump, slower one and tries to hit hard, but mistimed
outside the off stump, short of length and pulled away through the diving mid-wicket for a four!
on the middle stump, worked away to mid-wicket for a single to bring up his 50, it was Kohli who started timing them well to get the score moving
outside the off stump, short of length, missed the cut
round the wicket, on the middle, flicked away to square-leg for a single
six more, over extra cover region, pitched up this time, and he has been murdered over extra-cover!
no-ball for the height and that has been placed over point for a six. Yes, it was placed, almost guided and it was a quick one above waist, yet gets the timing!
pitched right up, pushed to long-on for a single
pitched up to the bat, driven to the extra-cover region and the gets that century that takes him to his third IPL century, and the first of the season. 53 balls only!
short of length, punched to the extra-cover region, they come back for the second just seconds before the umpire calls it a Time-Out
outside the off stump, tries to play it over again, but mistimes, but goes to mid-wicket for a single
six more, three in a row, this is effortless batting from Gayle, whether short or pitched up, Gayle's not sparing him now, fullish this time and deposited, ninth six for him
short of length ball from over the wicket, and that has been lofted over long-on, again on the front foot!
on his pads and that has been muscled away to deep square-leg, and it was done off the front foot to a good length ball
short of length, spinning away from the batsman, cuts it away and the fielder from the deep covers has to move to his left to field it
short of good length, punched down the ground for a single to retain the strike
slower one again, pitched up to the bat, flicked away to long-on for a single
outside the off stump, pitched and deviated away from the batsman, played away to third-man for a single
full-toss and whipped away to the wide long-on for a four, Kohli's moving towards his fifty too
pitched up to the bat, slower one outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and guides it to third-man for a single
outside the off stump, punched to the off side for a single
shorter again and it goes the same way that the previous one had, over deep square-leg for a six! This is sensational batting from Gayle, but haven't we come to expect that from him!
slower one and that has been pulled over square-leg for a six, shorter it was but the lack of pace would have made it difficult for Gayle, but no, it does not!
round the wicket, on his pads, tries to flick it away, but hits the pads
pitched up, this time it is not a slower one, and Gayle crunches it to long-off, the fielder was jumping up there, gets his hand and tips it over the fence
rolls his fingers over the ball, Kohi waits for the delivery, cuts it away to the deep cover for a single
slower one, sat up outside the off stump to be hit and Gayle bashed it away to long-off for a single
pitched up again and it is driven to long-off for a single to retain the strike

casually punched over the bowler, and that has gone for a four! It was pitched up alright but when he hit it, it hardly looked like he was attempting a four, instead it beats the long-off fielder with ease
on his pads, flicked it away to deep fine-leg for a couple of runs
short of length, punched back to the bowler, who fields well

on the off stump, pitched right up and driven to the extra-cover region, the long-off fielder runs to his right and dives to attempt the save, misfield again and it has gone for a four to bring up his half century
fuller on the off stump, driven in the air over the bowler for a single
powerfully punched down the ground, and it was going straight to the fielder, Yadav, who was sliding to his left to save it, but the power of the stroke beats him and that goes for a four!
shot, that is sincerely a huge six, it came off really well off the bat slammed over mid-wicket
goes down the track and drives it to long-off for a single
on his pads, short of length, pushed to deep mid-wicket for a single
outside the off stump and he wants to swing it away over mid-wicket, misses for a change
round the wicket, on the middle stump and lofted over the bowler, but fielded well by Warner straight down the ground
short of a good length, on the leg side, Kohli was going down the track, before pushing it to square-leg for a single
slower one, Gayle was moving around in his crease, finally flicked away to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, pitched right up and driven to extra cover
outside the off stump, short of length too, Kohli pushes it back to the right of the bowler, who dives but misfields, goes to long-on for a single
outside the off stump, short of length, pushes to short extra-cover
outside the off stump, short of length, punched to the extra cover region, goes to Jayawardene who does well to field, but misses hitting the stumps at the no-striker's end
short of length, pushed to the long-on for a single
outside the off-stump, but in the slot and that has been short-arm-jabbed over long-on for a six!
short of length, outside the off stump, punched back to the left of the bowler and despite his dive, there is a single
round the wicket, outside the off stump, driven to the wide long-on region where Yadav tries to field using only one hand and it goes through!
shorter, outside the off stump, driven to long-off for a single
pitched right up to the bat, driven back forcefully but to the bowler
floated up and driven to the backward point but to the fielder and they get no run
short of length again, goes to the back foot and driven to Jayawardene at short cover
short of length, forced back to the bowler, who misfields to allow Gayle a single
outside the off stump, pushed to the point fielder
outside the off stump, needed to reach out, cut away for a single
outside the off stump, up to the bat, driven confidently to short cover
pitched up to the bat, driven to long-on for a single
on his pads, pushed away the good length ball to mid-wicket for a single
pitched up and that has been deposited out of the boundary, it was in the slot for Gayle to take his foot away and smoke it over long-on
pitched up this time, outside the off stump, slower one, checks his stroke and drives to point
on his pads, short of length and that is merely timed away to back ward square-leg for a four, races away to the fence
pitched up to the bat, easily driven to long-on for a single
slower ball from Pathan, keeps a tad low too and Kohli adjusts his stroke to pull it away to mid-wicket for a single
outside the off stump, it wasn't quick, needs to hit hard to play it through the covers and the mistiming helps them come back for a second
short of length this time, on the pads again, pushed to deep mid-wicket for a single
on his pads, full toss, easy pickings for the batsman, he flicks it away to fine-leg for a four
on his pads, length ball, worked to square-leg outside the circle for a single
outside the off stump, slower, short of good length, pushed to the off side
pitched right up to the batsman and he can only drive it to the extra-cover, half the side is on the off side inside the circle and there is no way he can pierce it
gives himself room, wanting to bulldoze it away, but isn't getting the room, driven to mid-off
short of length, Gayle goes on to the back foot, and is forced into defending it
full-toss and he tries to swing it over square-leg, gets an outside edge and flies to third-man on the bounce, only a single
short of length, on the back foot and defended to the off side, called a no-ball though which means that we have a Free Hit
shorter ball again, slower probably, pulls it away to the deep square-leg region for a single
outside the off stump, not as quick, tries to cut it away but to the fielder
short ball and pulled away to the deep square-leg region for a four, he starts and ends the over with a four.
shorter, outside the off stump, punch attempted but the bounce defeats the stroke, to the off side
outside the off stump, pitched up but slower from Aaron and the umpire deems that the batsman cannot get to it, calls it a wide
outside the off stump, short of length, pushed to the off side and to the fielder
on the leg side, short of length, tapped to square-leg and to the fielder, 145.3 km/hr
pitched up this time, on the off stump and defended back to the bowler
another one pitched up and Kohli caresses it through the on-side, finding the gap between square-leg and mid-wicket for a four!
short ball, hurries Gayle into playing it, pushes to the leg side, loops up but falls short of short mid-wicket
yorker length, on the middle stump and dabbed away to the leg side for a single
short of length, on the middle stump, pushed back to the bowler, who fields on follow-through
he shifts his line to outside the off stump, punched through the covers for a four this time!
classic, delightfully flicked away, it was pitched on the leg stump, up to the bat and he has drilled it through square-leg for a four
on his pads, short of length and flicked away to fine-leg for a couple of runs
and again, this it is slashed away over extra-cover for four. Did not hit the middle of the bat by any stretch, it was outside the off stump, slashed over the in field on the up and for a four
pitched up and drilled straight back over the bowler, one bounce and four, finally gets away does Gayle
outside the off stump, punched to the off side where point fields, eight dots against Gayle
pitched right up to the batsman, almost a yorker-length ball and it is defended back by Gayle

leading edge, caught and Aaron has a wicket! It was on the middle stump, gets a leading edge that goes high in the air, there was a clutch of fielders wanting to converge on it, but it went to Irfan Pathan at mid-on to snap that up!
middle stump line, pitched up, driven back to the bowler
short of good length and would you believe it, Yadav has just sent down a maiden to Gayle in a T20 game. It does not change even after I pinch myself hard.
pitched up, on the off stump and Gayle wanted to spank it over the in field but misses yet again, that is a good start from Yadav!
short of length, outside the off stump and he tries to cut it away, does well to get it to the covers but a diving stop from Negi saves the fout
this time close to the batsman, tries to cut it away but not only was it swinging away but also very pacy, beats the outside edge of the bat
outside the off stump yet again, short of the driving length and Gayle watchfully lets it go through to the keeper
outside the off stump, quick from Yadav, left alone by Gayle
and four more, outside the off-stump, driven to the left of Pathan this time and it rushes away to the fence again!
pitched up, swinging in and Dilshan accounts for the swing and drives it back, slightly wide off Pathan's right and it runs away for a four!
but this time it does not miss the bat, a similar ball, swinging into the batsman, flicked away to deep square-leg for a couple of runs, Yadav slides and saves the four
swung in a little, was shaping to flick it away to the leg side but the swing beats him and it nudges his pads through to the wicket-keeper
outside the off stump, fuller from Pathan and driven by Dilshan, straight to short cover where the stand-in captain Jayawardene fields
on a length, bit of swing from Pathan away from the bat, outside edge to third-man for a single
goes for a big one but straight to the fielder deep and that is the end of the game, Bangalore have picked up two points here
slower, shorter and he goes for a swing, misses and it has gone to the keeper
on the leg stump, moves away to the leg side and drives to long-on for a single
down the leg side and it is called a wide
moving around the crease, slower one delivered and the edge goes high in the air and for Kohli to take a good catch at long-off, end of Russell and dare I say, Delhi's chances in this game too!
round the wicket, tries to slam it back, but goes to the bowler, four sixes needed now
pitched right up to the bat and that has been smashed back over the bowler for a six! Hits the sight-screen and rather hard at that!
round the stumps, pitched right up to the bat, digs out the yorker and that gives them only a single
swatted away over the mid-wicket region for a six, short of a length, it was not too well-timed but his power takes it over the fence
outside the off stump, the batsman slips and is flat on ground, parallel to the crease.
short of good length, driven to the long-off region for a single
outside the off stump, wants to play it away aggressively, but misses, it was slower too
short of length, almost a bouncer, tries to pull it, gets a top edge and it goes over the keeper for a four.
length ball, tries to go over the top but no timing, goes to long-off for only a single
full toss outside the off stump and drilled down the ground yet again, to the long-off fielder, only seven off the over
swung away at a length ball and straight into the hands of the deep mid-wicket fielder, easily caught by Dilshan
tries to flick it over fine-leg, scoop attempted, but gets the toe-end of the bat, to deep square-leg for a couple of runs
yorker length ball, round the wickets, outside edge goes to point, where a tumbling Gayle fields and there is only a single
full-toss and he was moving around in the crease before slashing him over extra-cover for a couple of runs, a bit of misfield there as well, but in the end, only a couple
full-toss and on the pads, hoicked to deep square-leg but to the fielder and only a single
slower one, shorter, beats the batsman this time, and that has brought the equation up to 17 an over for the next three overs.
pitched right up to the batsman, drilled to the long-on fielder for a single
shorter one from him, smacks him to long-on for a single
short ball and that is pulled away to the leg side, between deep square-leg and mid-wicket for a four, it was only a few yards away from the fielder but he barely got to it!

short ball and top-edged away to the leg side, holed out! Taylor had been smacking those away to mid-wicket but the momentum seemed to have stalled, goes straight to hands and they have now lost two wickets quickly
short of length, tries to pull it, hard into the ground, to the leg side for a single
yorker length, 137 km/hr, dug out by Russell and it goes to the third-man fielder for a single
what? wasn't that supposed to be the first ball he was facing? Yes it was, and pitched up, Russell has teed away over the bowler's head for a six, more than 100 metres away for sure!
pitched right up to the bat, middle stump and he tries to go over the fence, does not get too much bat on it, straight to the fielder at the fence
outside the off stump, short of length, drilled through extra-cover and it looked like was going to the fence, but a dive at the fence by Kohli restricts him to a couple
yorker length ball, swinging into the batsman, dug out but not for any runs
round the stumps, outside the off stump, tries to go for the drive, misses the outside edge

outside the off stump and on a length, that was timed away over the in-field on the off side, it was hit well but Dilshan did well to run to his right to field that on the bounce, single is all they get
outside the off stump, quicker one, tries to cut it away but misses, through to the keeper on the bounce
short of length, wants to swing it away, hit straight to the short fine-leg fielder and they get a single
almost cleaned up, was the umpire there, good length ball and Taylor has slapped it back to the bowler, who had no business getting his hand in the way, misses him, the umpire and fielder at long-on
outside the off stump, tries to heave it away again and misses, through to the keeper, one of those rare ones
quicker ball, inside edge through to fine-leg and they get a single only.

and the end of Murali's spell for the night is with a six that brings up Taylor's half-century, outside the off stump and he slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for maximum, you can have as many players there but when it sails over them...
outside the off stump, cuts it away to the fine third-man and they get a single
shorter ball from Murali, but there are three of them on the leg side and it goes straight to one of them
down the leg side and missed by Taylor, wide called
outside the off stump, shorter this time and cut away to the fielder within the circle at extra-cover, a single
attempts another sweep to a ball outside the off stump, and it goes on a few bounces to the backward square-leg
down the leg side, beats the short fine-leg and they come back for the second before he can retrieve the ball
shorter this time, outside the off stump and pushed to the off side for a single

outside the the off stump, Taylor wants to play that slog as well and would you believe it, there is no fielder on the leg side outside the circle, the mis-hit beats the fielders at square-leg and short fine-leg and it goes to the fence!
outside the off stump, short of length, cut away through the point region and they get a single
outside the off stump, driven through the covers and Zak misfields, goes to wide long-off and they are able to come back for a couple
pitched right up to the batsman, middle stump and he has been straight-batted over the bowler for a four!
outside the off stump, short of length, driven for a single
slog swept once again, and this time it goes on the bounce to the deep mid-wicket fielder, only a single
swept away once more, four more again, this was a bottom edge and beats the short fine-leg fielder, who dives over it and it goes for a four!
swept away again by Taylor, the slog sweep has already been a productive stroke for him tonight and he gets a four

down the track and that has been taken, caught! For most part of the path of the ball, I thought it was going over the fence, in the end, it might have bounced before the fence had it not been caught but that is an excellent running catch from long-off, to his right, almost grabs it with one hand in the end!
quicker on his pads, tries to whip it away, hits the pads, single
outside the off stump, goes for a sweep and it almost bisects the fielders deep on the on-side, but in the end they take only one
pitched up, drilled through the covers and while it was in the air, it is away from extra-cover within the circle, a single for the batsman
round the stumps, not too quick, opens the face of the bat to guide it to third-man, getting to his highest score this IPL
cracked it through mid-wicket for a four, pitched outside the off stump and he goes to the pitch of the bat, before swatting it away to the on-side for a boundary
outside the off stump, short of length, opens the face of the bat, to third-man for a single
outside the off stump, slower one as well, comes forward to push it to the off side for a single
outside the off stump, short of length and slapped away to the deep cover for a four
slog swept away for a six! Taylor loves playing those hockey swipes and he hits them well when in form, slaps it away for a six...
round the stumps, cut away by Taylor through the backward point region for a four!
over the wicket, tries to slap it away, gets a leading edge from the toe end, goes to long-on
round the wicket, quicker to the batsman, goes on to the back foot, dabbed to the leg side
on the off stump, turning it, played well to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, pushed his foot out, defends and after an initial hesitation, they decide to go for a single
slashed over point for a four, the third in the over and that will help the Daredevils, it was pitched up and he hit it hard

outside the off stump, tries to cut it away, gets bit of an inside edge, Gayle from the slips has a shy at the stumps, misses and there was no-one to back the throw up, rolls over to the deep fence down the ground
cut away fine and for four, brings Taylor his first runs of the game
short of length, pushed to the off side and to the fielder
outside the off stump, short of length, cut away to point where Gayle fields.
outside the off stump and edged away to AB behind the stumps, end of MJ and Delhi are staring down the wrong end.
pitched and spanked over long-on for a six, good end to an over which was going Bangalore's way.
slower one, pitched up to the bat, outside the off stump and driven to long-on for a single
on the middle stump, and defended back to the bowler by MJ, the rate's gone up to 12.5
outside the off stump, crashed away to the third-man for a single
on the front foot, defended to the off side for a single
outside the off stump and driven to the extra-cover fielder, Kohli, who shies at the non-strik-er's end after fumbling a little, had that hit, he was walking back
on the middle stump, flicked away to short fine-leg for a single to Zaheer Khan
outside the off stump and Rao has cut it away hard to the fielder, excellent shot for a single
down the leg side, top-spinner attempted, swept away really fine for a four!
tries to scoop it from outside the off stump, gets the toe of the bat and goes to square-leg
on the off stump again, flicked it away to the mid-wicket for a couple of runs
outside the off stump, MJ tries to hit it over long-on but without any foot movement, misses
pitched up, MJ was attempted the scoop over the short fine-leg but gets a bit of leading edge and it goes to deep square-leg for a single
short of length, pushed to the covers and to the fielder
short of length, tries to pull it away, inside edge for a single
short from the bowler and MJ pulls it away to deep square-leg for a single
on the middle stump, played away to the wide mid-on region for a single
outside the off stump, pitched on the good length, wanted to drive but fails in the endeavour this time, misses the outside edge through to the keeper
on the middle stump, MJ pulls his front foot out to the ball, defends it back to the bowler
short of length, bounces a bit higher on MJ, who gracefully defends to the off side
outside the off stump, cut away to the third-man for a single
pulled away to the deep square-leg for a single
and now a bit of an image-taint, disappointing shot this, short ball, pulled to the mid-on fielder who takes the catch easily, low down.
short from Vinay Kumar and that has been pulled over mid-wicket for a six! He is all of 19 years of age and is doing his reputation no harm!
on the middle stump, jagging back into the bat, driven to the off side for a single
on his pads again, and this time he dabs it through the fine-leg for a four, there was a short fine-leg in place but that was beating him easily
opens the face of the bat, through to third-man for a single
the angle again but this time it is fuller and that has been spanked over the mid-wicket region for another four
round the wicket, angles into the right-hander batsman, gets a bit of an inside-edge to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, pitched right up to the bat, cover driven in the air and through for four
pitched fuller this time and there is a bit of swing for Kumar, goes for a drive, misses it completely and through to the keeper
short of length, wants to pull it away, climbs up on him, misses the timing
outside the off stump, trying to cut it away, misses it and it goes through to the keeper
short of length, a bit of bounce for the bowler, pushed to square-leg for a single
cut away to the fence for a four, shorter and outside the off stump, cut to the fence, sizzles away!
on the middle stump, short of length, pushed back to the bowler
on the off stump, angling away from the right hander and it is pushed to the covers
on his pads, flicked away to fine-leg for a single

gone, caught, the ball's in the hands of mid-off, the bat's some place unknown. Short of length, Warner was hitting them hard, and he attempted another one there, gets the top edge and the bat slips out of his hand too, lobs up to Vinay Kumar who was back-pedalling and he takes a good catch there
slashed away over extra-cover for a six! Pitched up and Warner has scooped it over the in-field on the off side and to the fence
tries to powerfully hit it away, gets an inside edge and almost rolls over to the stumps, almost!
angling into the batsman, was shaping up for a stroke, but only pushed to the bowler
on his pads, played away to the leg side for a single
quicker, shorter, cut to the covers
quicker one, right arm round, misses the bat and there is a loud appeal, given not-out!
pitched up and he has dispatched the bowler, inside out for a four, almost a six to deep cover!
cut away off the first ball he faces to the cover boundary for four, it was on the middle stump, rushing in but well playd
pitched right up to the bat, driven to deep mid-wicket for a single
down the leg side, quicker, wide to start off with
